finding: Slovak turnover improved but remained negative, profit gap versus EA persists
bullets: A net 13% of Slovak firms (n=242) reported falling turnover in wave 39, improving 13 pp from the previous wave's net 26% decline, while the EA posted a net 8% increase.
A net 34% of Slovak firms (n=242) reported declining profits, improving 5 pp from the previous wave's net 40% decline, versus a net 15% decline across the euro area.
Labour costs rose for a net 79% of Slovak firms (n=242), easing 5 pp from the previous wave but remaining 20 pp above the euro area's net 59%.
chart_subtitle: Slovak turnover net balance rose to −13% in wave 39.
